$comment: Theme palette data — the single source of truth for the color themes.
`src/styles/globals.css` from this file; `src/theme/palettes.ts` reads it for
the terminal palettes and the Shiki themes. Edit here, then regenerate.
Token names are the `--color-*` names from `@theme` minus the `search-*`
tokens, which are shared by every theme on purpose.
